fields.v: Agent Claude Code + Claude Sonnet 4.6, 33 tasks x 10 runs per side. No success criterion stated by the authors (pass rate and footprint deltas reported). (a) Cleaner side: pass rate 0.913; footprint vs messier: input tokens -7.1%, output -8.5%, reasoning chars -11.1%, conversation messages -7.0%, messages before first edit -3.6%, chars before first edit -4.6%, files read +3.2%, revisits -33.8%, lines edited -3.2%; quality and cost verdicts: no criterion stated by the authors. (b) Messier side (reference): pass rate 0.921; absolute token values not reported; verdicts: no criterion stated by the authors. (c) Ablation, comment-normalised pairs (4 pairs, n = 5 per cell): input-token delta sonar-caas-poc +1.2% -> -18.0% (LOC-adjusted +2.9% -> -13.0%), sonar-sca +1.3% -> -8.5%, sonarcloud-codedatalake -29.0% -> -30.6%, genie +5.2% -> +3.0%; no criterion stated. Claude Code + Claude Haiku 4.5 swept but excluded (pass rate too low to read footprint; values not reported)

fields.v: Project/tasks: 33 author-authored tasks on 6 behaviourally equivalent minimal pairs (3 Slopify, 3 Vibeclean), routed through hotspots, described in externally observable terms, hidden tests at public surface, reference implementations; three tracks (13 cognitive-hotspot, 14 multi-module, 6 calibration as neutral control). Configurations compared: cleaner vs messier side of each pair. Baseline: messier side (deltas relative to it). Held constant: agent (Claude Code, default tools), model (Sonnet 4.6), task description, sandbox (identical except /app source tree), agent blind to side. Acceptance tests: hidden test suites (reference passes both sides; untouched repo fails). Repetitions: 10 per task per side (5 in ablation). Human intervention: none during runs. Ablation: comment and suppression-marker normalisation

fields.v: Pass rate unchanged: 0.913 cleaner vs 0.921 messier (-0.9 pp). Cleaner code: input tokens -7.1%, output -8.5%, reasoning chars -11.1%, conversation messages -7.0%, file revisitation -33.8% (same direction on every repo, -7% ckan to -69% commons-bcel), files read +3.2%. By track: multi-module pass -2.6 pp, input -10.7%, revisits -50.8%; cognitive-hotspot pass +0.1 pp, input +1.8%, files read +11.2%, revisits -20.2%; calibration 0.0 pp, input +3.8%. Per-task input-token deltas -47% to +44% (median -4.5%), cleaner cheaper on 16 of 27 tasks. Comment normalisation strengthens or keeps the effect; markers negligible. No significance test reported

fields.v: Partly: distinguished the sides on footprint (pooled over hundreds of trials) but not on pass rate; calibration track flat as expected (sanity check). Trial-to-trial variance large (max/min input tokens about 2.5x per group, over 2x in 72% of groups); a per-task delta of about 10% may be noise; no statistical test. Limitations stated: author-curated end to end (selection bias), one configuration, tokens not dollars, hidden tests only, comment normalisation manual and variable

fields.v: Limitations: repositories, pairs and tasks all author-curated; one configuration (Claude Code + Sonnet 4.6; Haiku too noisy; no GPT/Gemini or other harnesses), Python and Java only; tokens as cost proxy, not dollars; only hidden tests checked, not existing repository tests; no SonarQube scan of agent output; 'cleaner'/'messier' are within-pair labels; short-horizon only. Gaps: whether per-task savings compound over long-term agent-driven evolution (port minimal pairs to SlopCodeBench-style settings); whether agents on cleaner code produce cleaner code; transfer to other models and harnesses
